summary: The October current-authority adapter and generator-side trusted root binding now feed the unchanged Story 18.1 issuer with an exact approval and deployment-owned root, fail closed on revoked/unavailable authority, and preserve caller-owned context lifetime.

behavioral_red.execution: outside sandbox after a superseded CS2012 output denial
behavioral_red.observation: All cases reached the declaration-only verifier or binding shells; no test or environment defect remained.

sandbox_result.classification: documented restricted Windows ancestor-handle RootUnavailable boundary

test_owner_assessment: Tests use the actual verifier, generator binding, unchanged issuer/context and owned temporary roots. They cover exact target/batch/Repository/root-version mapping, Current/Revoked/Unavailable, separate Repository contexts, authority loss before disclosure, cancellation, settlement and caller disposal. Existing three-function schema tests remain unchanged. No refactor was needed.
production_owner_assessment: Verifier forwards the exact approval and maps current authority without caching; binding resolves only its immutable exact tuple and supplies the physical root solely to the trusted issuer. No Story 18.1 contract or Worker tool changed. No post-GREEN refactor was justified.
qualification_limit: Owned local prepared roots and controlled authority responses only; no production Web transport, mutual TLS or deployment root provisioning is claimed.
